title: Witchhammer
writer: Václav Kaplický, Otakar Vávra, Ester Krumbachová
actors: Vladimír Smeral, Elo Romancik, Josef Kemr
plot: In the 1600s, an overzealous clergy hauls innocent women in front of tribunals, forces them to confess to imaginary witchery, and engages in brutal torture and persecution of their subjects.
